subtopics.label: iPSC Generation, Reprogramming, and Pluripotency
subtopics.description: Research on the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), mechanisms of cellular reprogramming, and maintenance of pluripotency, including epigenetic regulation, chromatin dynamics, and gene regulatory networks governing stem cell identity.

subtopics.label: Organoid Models for Disease and Drug Screening
subtopics.description: Development and application of organoid systems derived from pluripotent or tissue-specific stem cells to model human diseases, study pathogen infection, and perform drug screening, including brain, lung, cardiac, intestinal, and pancreatic organoids.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Differentiation, Regeneration, and Cardiomyocyte Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on cardiomyocyte differentiation from pluripotent stem cells, cardiac regeneration mechanisms, cardiomyocyte division and polyploidy, and iPSC-derived cardiac models for disease modeling and cardiotoxicity screening.

subtopics.label: Zebrafish Heart and Tissue Regeneration Models
subtopics.description: Use of zebrafish as a model organism to study heart regeneration, epicardial progenitor activation, lymphatic vessel development, and tissue repair mechanisms including regulatory elements and signaling pathways governing regenerative responses.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Biology and Clonal Hematopoiesis
subtopics.description: Research on hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) biology, including self-renewal, differentiation, epigenetic regulation, clonal hematopoiesis mutations (DNMT3A, SF3B1, JAK2), and aging-associated remodeling of the hematopoietic system.

subtopics.label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation and Clinical Applications
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on hematopoietic stem cell transplantation including cord blood transplantation, haplo-identical approaches, engraftment kinetics, cryopreservation, and shared care models for improving transplant access and outcomes.

subtopics.label: Neural Stem Cells, Neurogenesis, and Brain Organoid Models
subtopics.description: Research on neural stem cell self-renewal, neuronal differentiation, and brain organoid models used to study neurodevelopmental disorders (schizophrenia, ASD), neurodegeneration, and the effects of pathogens or drugs on neural progenitor biology.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Differentiation, Function, and Regeneration
subtopics.description: Studies on pancreatic beta cell differentiation, identity maintenance, functional regulation, and regenerative strategies including iPSC-derived beta cells, transplantation models, and molecular targets for diabetes therapy.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelial Stem and Progenitor Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on airway basal stem and progenitor cells including their differentiation, response to injury or infection (HIV, SARS-CoV-2, smoking), and role in lung disease such as COPD, with organoid and in vitro models of airway epithelium.

subtopics.label: Tissue Engineering, Biomaterials, and Scaffold-Based Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of biomaterial scaffolds, decellularized matrices, and 3D-printed constructs for tissue engineering applications including cartilage, nipple, nasal, and skin reconstruction, as well as vascularized tissue constructs.

subtopics.label: Endothelial and Vascular Progenitor Cell Biology
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial progenitor cells, endothelial cell identity maintenance, angiogenesis, and vascular development including lineage tracing, transcription factor regulation, and applications in organoid vascularization and tissue regeneration.

subtopics.label: Skeletal Stem Cells, Osteoblast Differentiation, and Bone Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on osteoblast and skeletal stem cell differentiation, signaling pathways regulating bone formation and mineralization (hedgehog, ERK MAPK, GSK3-β), and skeletal stem cell contributions to bone homeostasis and disease.

subtopics.label: Adipocyte Differentiation and Adipose Tissue Biology
subtopics.description: Research on preadipocyte and adipocyte differentiation, adipogenesis regulation, and adipose tissue biology including circadian control, epigenetic regulators, metabolic signaling, and the role of adipose progenitors in metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Lineage Plasticity, Cancer Stem Cells, and Cell Fate Transitions
subtopics.description: Research on cancer cell lineage plasticity, transdifferentiation, and cancer stem cell biology including epigenetic reprogramming, tumor cell identity transitions, and the role of stem cell transcription factors in tumor initiation and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte Biology, Liver Regeneration, and Chimeric Mouse Models
subtopics.description: Research on primary human hepatocyte culture, expansion, and transplantation using chimeric mouse models, including liver repopulation strategies, disease modeling (NAFLD), and gene therapy applications in humanized liver systems.

subtopics.label: Glioblastoma Stem Cells and Tumor Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research on glioblastoma stem cell biology, including the role of the tumor microenvironment (hypoxia, chromatin remodeling, neural development mimicry) in maintaining GSC states and driving tumor progression.

subtopics.label: KRAS Oncogenic Variants and Precision Cancer Modeling
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing distinct oncogenic KRAS alleles and their phenotypic consequences in pancreatic, lung, and other cancers, including in vivo allelic series and base-editing preclinical models.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic and Chromatin Regulation in Cancer and Differentiation
subtopics.description: Research on chromatin architecture, histone modifications, and epigenetic regulators (EZH2, BMI1, cohesin, histone H1, m6A) in cancer development, cell fate, and therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: m6A RNA Modification and Epitranscriptomic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies on m6A mRNA methylation machinery including YTHDF proteins and METTL3, examining how epitranscriptomic modifications regulate mRNA stability, translation, and cell fate decisions.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Stem Cell Niche and Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on Lgr5+ intestinal stem cell biology, including niche support from lymphatics and fibroblasts, Wnt/NF-κB/PI3K signaling cross-talk, and lineage characterization methods.

subtopics.label: Nerve Regeneration, Peripheral Neuropathy, and Neural Repair
subtopics.description: Studies on peripheral nerve regeneration in diabetic neuropathy, spinal cord injury, and surgical nerve repair, including corneal nerve imaging, cytokine signaling, and corticospinal axon sprouting.

subtopics.label: Wound Healing, PRP, and Regenerative Injection Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on regenerative approaches to wound healing and musculoskeletal conditions, including alpha-gal nanoparticles, platelet-rich plasma/fibrin injections, and bone marrow aspirate for osteoarthritis.

subtopics.label: Intervertebral Disc Degeneration and Regenerative Strategies
subtopics.description: Studies on the biology of intervertebral disc degeneration and evaluation of regenerative therapies including non-stem-cell-based approaches targeting collagen production and disc biomechanics.

subtopics.label: Ovarian Follicle, Theca Cell, and Reproductive Biology
subtopics.description: Research characterizing human ovarian follicle biology including theca cell subtypes, antral follicle molecular signatures in xenografts, AMH signaling, and gamete generation methods.

subtopics.label: Breast Stem Cell Markers and Cancer Risk Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies examining the association of stem cell markers (CD44, CD24, ALDH1A1) in benign breast tissue with breast cancer risk, mammographic density, and reproductive/anthropometric factors.

subtopics.label: AML and Leukemia Stem Cell Biology and Therapy Resistance
subtopics.description: Research on acute myeloid leukemia stem cell maintenance, therapy-induced senescence, epigenetic heterogeneity, BCL6 survival signaling, and IDH/NPM1/FLT3 mutation cooperativity driving disease.

subtopics.label: CRISPR-Based Genome Editing for Disease Modeling and Functional Genomics
subtopics.description: Studies employing CRISPR/Cas9 and base-editing technologies to generate precise cancer models, B cell loss-of-function mutants, sex-reversed mice, and functional domain screens in stem and cancer cells.

subtopics.label: Wnt Signaling, Secretion, and Developmental Patterning
subtopics.description: Research on Wnt pathway components including WLS/Evi-mediated Wnt transport, Wnt/β-catenin cross-talk with other pathways, and OTX2-driven enhancer remodeling in definitive endoderm specification.

subtopics.label: Neurodegeneration, Microglia, and Tau Biology
subtopics.description: Studies on tau protein interactions with synaptic and mitochondrial processes in neurodegeneration, microglial population dynamics including MAC2+ progenitor-like cells, and progranulin-deficient FTD microglial signaling.

subtopics.label: Patient-Derived Xenograft and In Vivo Cancer Models
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and in vivo cancer models for hepatocellular carcinoma, HIV immunotherapy evaluation, and general cancer model characterization.
